items.title: Sarvam releases open-weight Sarvam-105B-1711 at $0.15/M blended tokens
items.summary: Sarvam AI released an update to its 105B mixture-of-experts model (10.3B active params) with Apache-2.0 weights, tuned for tool calling and agentic work. Blended API price is $0.15 per million tokens, down from $0.44. Benchmarks are Sarvam's own; voice agents are only listed as a target use case.
items.whyItMatters: A cheap, self-hostable tool-calling LLM is a possible low-cost brain for a voice tutor, though its focus is Indian languages and French quality is unverified.

items.title: Amazon reportedly nearing a $7.5B purchase of AI video startup Decart
items.summary: The Information, citing an FT report from Saturday, says Amazon is close to buying Israeli real-time video-model startup Decart for about $7.5B. Unconfirmed by the companies.
items.whyItMatters: Signals big-tech appetite for real-time generative video, the tech behind future avatar tutors.
